howToApply: Visit SAC website https://www.sac.gov.in or https://careers.sac.gov.in.
Register and fill the online application form from 10.09.2026 (1000 hrs) to 30.09.2026 (1700 hrs).
Upload recent colored passport size photograph (JPEG, less than 1 MB) and signature (aspect ratio 7:2, JPEG, less than 1 MB).

No application fee is required for any post.

fees.category: Reserved Category (All categories of Women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, Divyang, Ex-Servicemen)

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
Click on ‘Online Application’ and select ‘Apply’, then select GSSSB.
Click on the advertisement for Advertisement No. 457/202627, Class-3 cadre and click ‘Apply Now’.
Fill in ‘Personal Details’ (fields marked with * are mandatory).
Fill in ‘Educational Details’.
Accept the ‘Assurance’ (Baahendhari) terms by selecting ‘Yes’ and click ‘Save’. An Application Number will be generated – save it.
Upload Photograph (5 cm height x 3.6 cm width, passport size, white background, JPG format, max 15 KB) and Signature (2.5 cm height x 7.5 cm width, JPG format, max 15 KB).
Click ‘Confirm Application’, verify all details, and confirm. A Confirmation Number will be generated – save it for all future correspondence.
Pay the examination fee online (Debit Card / Internet Banking / UPI / Wallets) by 26/09/2026 (23:59 hrs). Obtain and save the fee receipt.
Print the application form and save it until the entire recruitment process is complete.

fees.category: Reserved (All categories of Women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, Divyang, Ex-Army)

howToApply: Visit https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
Click on ‘Apply Online’.
Click on ‘Helper’ category to view post details.
Click on ‘Apply Now’ to open the application form.
Fill in Personal Details (fields marked with red asterisk * are mandatory).
After Personal Details, click on ‘Educational Qualification’ to fill Minimum Educational Details.
Click on ‘Additional Educational Qualification’ to fill extra qualification details if applicable.
Click on ‘Computer Knowledge’ to fill computer qualification details.
Click on ‘Self Declaration’ and then click ‘Yes’ to accept terms.
Click ‘Save’ to submit the application online. Note your Application Number.

Click ‘Upload Photograph’ and enter your Application Number and Birth Date, then click OK. Upload Photo and Signature in JPG format (Photo: 5 cm x 3.6 cm, max 10 KB; Signature: 2.5 cm x 7.5 cm, max 10 KB).
Click ‘Confirm Application’, preview your application, make edits if needed, then click ‘Confirm Application’. Note your Confirmation Number.
All candidates (General/Reserved/Divyang/Ex-Army) must pay the Online Process Fee via ‘Online Payment of Fees’ using the Confirmation Number and Date of Birth through the Online Payment Gateway.
Click ‘Print Application’, enter Confirmation Number and Date of Birth, and print/save a copy of the application.
